meta.name: AICADBridge UI (index.html) — Dark Neon CAD Console
meta.description: The real product surface of AICADBridge: a near-black console panel with a single cyan accent. Source of all color/component language for the product object inside the website. Exact tokens extracted from index.html :root.

primary.role: single neon accent (interactive, active states, focus)

accent.role: the ONLY chromatic accent; everything else neutral

neutral.usage: layered dark surfaces (#0a→#1e) with a 3-step text ramp (#555/#888/#e8e8e8)

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast — near-black ground, near-white text, one mid-luminance neon accent used sparingly

typography.font_style_notes: Panel-scale UI: small type (9.5-14px) on fine grids. No serifs in the product; the site adds an editorial serif on the page, product keeps Inter. Code/status text uses monospace.

spacing.section_rhythm: tight 8-16px rhythms; rows separated by 1px borders, not white space

layout.grid_system: single 420px docked panel (right-docked palette) with 52px icon sidebar

shape.border_usage: 1px hairline borders (#1e1e1e / #2a2a2a) define every surface; inputs and cards 10-12px radius; chips 4-6px; toggles pill

elevation.shadow_style: layered dark with hairline borders (no colored shadows)
elevation.depth_cues: color intensity layering (#0a→#1a) and hairline borders

iconography.style: thin line SVG icons, monochrome, cyan on active

motion.entrance_pattern: status badges and messages append instantly (self-healing loop feedback)
motion.philosophy: functional immediacy — every state change (loading/healing/success/error) is a badge, not an animation

components.button_style: 10px-radius solid surface; primary = cyan fill with #fff text (accent), secondary = #1a1a1a ghost with 1px border
components.input_style: 10px-radius dark input (#1a1a1a), 1px border #2a2a2a, cyan border on focus
components.navigation_pattern: left icon rail (36px buttons, 10px radius) + top brand bar; settings via modal overlay
components.list_style: compact list rows with hover fill and active cyan-left-border
components.component_notes: Status is always delivered as a colored badge chip (loading ⏳ / healing 🔧 / success ✅ / error ❌) with translucent accent backgrounds — this is the product's emotional interface.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: an engineer's instrument panel at night

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents (translucent cyan glows, hairline borders) only
visual_language.whitespace_usage: compact utility spacing; structure from borders not white space
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: even tool density with one cyan focal point at a time
visual_language.focal_strategy: single active control / status badge highlighted in cyan

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate, explicit (badges, typing indicator, status chips)
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: surface fill (#1e1e1e) + cyan accent on hover
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: medium — every long op gets a live status line

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: guides next step (suggests a command to try)
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: explanatory, names the Fusion API reason, offers the fix

visual_effects.composite_notes: The product UI is intentionally flat. On the website the product screen (real screenshot / video) is the only dark, animated object on the warm editorial page — its cyan (#00b8d4) becomes the site's single accent token. Never invent gradients; the neon is one hex value.
